=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/scripts-pending-removal.md:Throughout the file (schema description, template, and all documentation) | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The registry requires removal preflight checks but provides no mechanism to validate or enforce them at removal time.
  WHY: Without automated validation, the documented process is unenforceable and scripts can be removed prematurely.
- CLAUDE.md:Throughout the file | flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The policy text mentions the preflight-check requirement but does not add any validation mechanism to prevent premature removal.
  WHY: The same enforcement gap leaves compliance dependent on manual behavior rather than the registry system.
- unattended_system_instructions.md:Throughout the file | flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The policy text mentions the preflight-check requirement but does not add any validation mechanism to prevent premature removal.
  WHY: The same enforcement gap leaves compliance dependent on manual behavior rather than the registry system.
- CLAUDE.md:Lines 585-586 (in diff) | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The "permanent — review annually" text is bolded here but not in the parallel registry and unattended docs.
  WHY: The inconsistent formatting may confuse readers about whether the emphasis is intentional.
- CLAUDE.md:Line 586 (in diff): "These checks are what protects" | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Subject-verb agreement is wrong; "checks" should pair with "protect" not "protects".
  WHY: The other two files use the grammatically correct "These checks protect".
- CLAUDE.md:line 599 ("§6 (naming immutability) still applies") | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: This cross-reference points to §6, but the naming-immutability rule is in §10.
  WHY: Agents following the reference will consult the wrong section and miss the rename rules.
- CLAUDE.md:lines 587-589 (renaming guidance) and the new §18.F addition | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new renaming guidance contains stale section-number references and contradictory instructions about ask flow, naming rules, and DB gate patterns.
  WHY: The document now points agents at the wrong sections, causing plan/implementation mismatches.
- unattended_system_instructions.md:lines 472-475 (cross-ref to §20.C) and lines 480 (cross-ref to §20.D) | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The §20.F block still references outdated section numbers from the previous revision.
  WHY: Plans generated against this file will point reviewers and implementers to the wrong place, breaking the registry surfacing contract.
- docs/scripts-pending-removal.md:top of file and the template block | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The template does not faithfully match the policy-mandated bullet formatting and preflight-check syntax.
  WHY: Copying it verbatim can produce entries that downstream parsing or review automation will reject or require cleanup.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
